workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.description: Approval processes that assets go through before they are approved.
workflows.loadFailed: We could not load the workflows
workflows.loadFailedHint: Check your connection and try again.
workflows.forbidden.title: You do not have access to workflows
workflows.forbidden.description: Managing approval workflows needs the workflow permission. Ask an administrator if you need it.
workflows.empty.title: No workflows yet
workflows.empty.description: Until a workflow applies, assets are approved or rejected directly by someone with approval rights. Create a workflow to add steps, deadlines and escalation.
workflows.empty.template: Tip: applying the Core template pack to this organisation creates a ready-made “Two-level approval” workflow. It is never bound to anything until you choose where it applies.
workflows.deleteBody: “{{name}}” will be removed. Assets that are already going through it finish with the steps they started with.
workflows.applies.title: Where it applies
workflows.applies.description: Choose which assets go through which workflow.
workflows.applies.needWorkflow: Create a workflow first, then choose where it applies.
workflows.bindings.title: Bindings
workflows.bindings.description: Send assets of a type, a region, or both through a workflow.
workflows.bindings.order: A folder default wins first. Otherwise the asset’s type and region are matched, then type only, then region only. If nothing matches, no workflow applies and the existing direct approve and reject is used.
workflows.bindings.needsTarget: Choose an asset type, a region, or both.
workflows.bindings.duplicate: Another binding already uses this type and region.
workflows.bindings.loadFailed: We could not load the bindings
workflows.folders.title: Folder defaults
workflows.folders.description: A folder’s default applies to everything inside it, including sub-folders, and wins over bindings.
workflows.folders.loadFailed: We could not load the folders
workflows.designer.notFound.title: That workflow does not exist
workflows.designer.notFound.description: It may have been deleted. Go back to the list to pick another or create a new one.
workflows.designer.name: Name
workflows.designer.descriptionHint: Shown in the list so people know when to use it.
workflows.designer.nameTaken: A workflow with this name already exists.
workflows.designer.startFromHint: Replaces the steps below. Roles are matched by name, so they must exist in this organisation.
workflows.designer.startFromConfirmBody: You have changed the steps. Starting from a template discards those changes.
workflows.flow.title: Flow
workflows.flow.submittedHint: Someone sends an asset for review
workflows.flow.insertAtStart: Add a step at the start
workflows.flow.insertAtEnd: Add a step at the end
workflows.flow.orphans.title: Not connected
workflows.flow.orphans.description: Nothing leads to these steps, so they would never run. Point a step’s “On approve” or “On reject” at them, or delete them.
workflows.flow.keyboardHint: Use the arrow keys to move between steps and Delete to remove one.
workflows.step.deleteBody: “{{name}}” will be removed. Steps that led to it will lead to what it led to.
workflows.inspector.name: Step name
workflows.inspector.assigneesHint: Anyone with one of these roles, or any of these people.
workflows.inspector.mode.anyHint: One task is offered to everyone listed. The first person to decide settles the step.
workflows.inspector.mode.allHint: Every listed role and person gets their own task. All of them must approve, and one rejection rejects the step.
workflows.inspector.slaHint: Leave empty for no deadline. Hours are wall-clock hours, 1 to 8760.
workflows.inspector.escalateHint: Overdue tasks are also offered to these people.
workflows.inspector.escalateNeedsSla: Set a deadline above, or nothing is ever overdue.
workflows.inspector.onApproveHint: Where an approved step goes next.
workflows.inspector.onRejectHint: The reviewer’s comment becomes the reason when it returns to draft.
workflows.inspector.idHint: Used in the stored definition. Lowercase letters, digits, - and _.
workflows.inspector.idTaken: Another step already uses this id.
workflows.inspector.cannotDeleteLast: A workflow needs at least one step.
workflows.inspector.autoPublish: Publish automatically after the final approval
workflows.inspector.autoPublishHint: The asset is published straight away, as long as it could be published by hand (required metadata complete). Otherwise it stays approved.
workflows.inspector.distinct: The same person cannot approve two steps
workflows.inspector.distinctHint: Segregation of duties: one person cannot approve two different steps of the same asset, nor stand in for two parallel tasks.
workflows.inspector.selectHint: Select a step on the flow to edit it. These settings apply to the whole workflow.
workflows.picker.rolesFailed: Roles could not be loaded. Type a role name exactly as it appears in Roles.
workflows.picker.peopleUnavailable: People search is not available to you.
workflows.issues.title: Problems
workflows.issues.checked: Checked by the server: all good.
workflows.issues.name: Give the workflow a name.
workflows.issues.hint: Checks run as you edit. “Check” also confirms roles and people exist.
workflows.json.label: Workflow definition (JSON)
workflows.json.hint: Edit the stored definition directly. Valid JSON is applied as you type; switch back to Visual to see it laid out.
workflows.leave.title: Leave without saving?
workflows.leave.body: You have unsaved changes to this workflow. If you leave now they are lost.
